name: kkirikkiri-codex
description: Codex-native team builder from natural language — diagnoses whether to split work, runs Agent Teams or a deterministic Workflow spec with user-chosen model tiers (Fable/Opus/Sonnet, Haiku opt-in), self-run gates (wf-lint / card-lint / done-gate), shared memory and bounded runtime-spawned teammates.

interface.shortDescription: Assemble and run a Codex-native agent team
interface.longDescription: Package the Codex-native `kkirikkiri` workflow: cut-line diagnosis (single session / Agent Teams / Workflow), 2-3 question interview, shared model-tier selection that is preserved into cards and spawns, archetype + domain-card synthesis, execution shapes (parallel / serial / chain / fanout / tournament), external CLI workers (codex / agy / gjc / grok), and the gate scripts (wf-lint, card-lint, done-gate, model-selection, prepare-team) run as explicit checklist steps since Codex plugins have no hooks.
defaultPrompt: Assemble a small Codex-native team to research this topic and keep the lead role local.
Split this delegated coding request into a lead plus bounded worker roles with shared memory and boundary blocks.
Use kkirikkiri to run a deterministic Workflow spec over these N items with an adversarial-verify stage.
